decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing various spells and creatures to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures and then bring them back onto the battlefield with the reanimation abilities provided by cards like Persist and Unearth. This allows the deck to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty early in the game, while also disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize. The deck aims to set up a quick and powerful board presence to win the game before the opponent has a chance to respond effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing blink effects to continuously exile and return powerful creatures to the battlefield, triggering their enter the battlefield abilities multiple times. This strategy aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells, while also gaining card advantage through repeated blink effects. By combining aggressive creatures with blink effects, the deck can create a powerful tempo advantage and outvalue the opponent in longer games.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells that can deal damage quickly. It utilizes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production and includes cards that can control the opponent's board or disrupt their plans. The focus is on maintaining a fast pace and putting pressure on the opponent to react, forcing them to make suboptimal decisions and ultimately leading to victory through speed and aggression.

This deck focuses on cycling through cards and manipulating the graveyard to eventually cast Living End, a powerful sorcery that returns all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. By using cards like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent to cycle through the deck quickly, the player aims to fill their graveyard with creatures before casting Living End to bring them back and overwhelm the opponent with a sudden board presence. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation and Subtlety to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Allosaurus Combo by utilizing cards like Neoform and Eldritch Evolution to search for key pieces like Allosaurus Rider. The strategy involves ramping up mana quickly with cards like Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant and Xenagos, God of Revels to effectively execute the combo. The deck includes cards like Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer for protection and interaction, while also incorporating cards like Consign to Memory for additional utility. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently combo off and overwhelm opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with powerful creatures and spells. The deck includes strong aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, as well as supportive cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Thraben Charm to control the battlefield. With efficient removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment, the deck aims to maintain board presence and pressure opponents to win the game swiftly. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Phage, Titan of Fire's Fury adds additional versatility and finishing power to the deck.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blink effects to disrupt and outpace opponents. By using cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, you can repeatedly exile and return creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to trigger their abilities multiple times. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide disruption and removal, while Quantum Riddler and Witch Enchanter offer card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast creatures and powerful abilities, making it difficult for them to keep up with your tempo.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bring them back into play with cards like Persist and Unearth. By utilizing Faithless Looting, Though Scour, and other cards to discard creatures, the player can reanimate them with ease. Cards like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones provide powerful threats that can quickly end the game once they hit the board. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast reanimated creatures and disrupt their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push.

The deck focuses on utilizing the UrzaTron lands to quickly ramp up mana and cast powerful Eldrazi creatures. It also includes control elements such as counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The presence of Karn, the Great Creator allows for versatile sideboard options to further control the game. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence with big threats like Devourer of Destiny and Sire of Seven Deaths while staying ahead in mana advantage to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Faithless Looting and Thought Scour. Then, utilizing reanimation spells such as Unearth and Persist to bring back these creatures onto the battlefield for a quick and powerful combo finish. Hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push help control the opponent's board while the deck focuses on assembling its combo pieces. The deck also includes some unexpected cards like Psychic Frog and Troll of Khazad-dû to disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures that can be repeatedly blinked in and out of play to generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Solitude, the deck can protect its creatures while also removing threats from the opponent's board. Haliya, Guided by Light and Starfield Shepherd provide additional value by granting bonuses to creatures entering the battlefield. With a mix of efficient removal spells and resilient creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently through rituals and cantrips, in order to power out powerful combos involving Ral, Monsoon Mage and Grapeshot to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. It also includes cards like Past in Flames and Wish to help recur key spells and search for specific combo pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and close out the game in a single explosive turn.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also includes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls to give additional support and buffs to the creatures. The inclusion of cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Arena of Glory help to generate card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, aggressive, and efficient in dealing damage.

The main idea of the deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Disciple of Freyalise and Generous Ent, then use Eldritch Evolution and Neoform to tutor and cheat out Allosaurus Rider to the battlefield. This dinosaur creature can then be sacrificed to bring out Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant for a huge creature advantage. Other combo pieces like Planar Genesis and Ureni, the Song Unending help provide additional support and win conditions. The deck also includes protection with Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer to ensure the combo goes off smoothly.

The main concept of this Combo - Reanimator Modern deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Faithless Looting and Thought Scour. Once the graveyard is filled, you can use cards like Unearth and Persist to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a powerful combo. In addition, cards like Abhorrent Oculus and Psychic Frog can help you manipulate your graveyard and control your opponent's hand. Overall, this deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures to overwhelm your opponent.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disruption and removal, utilizing a combination of countermagic, hand disruption, and removal spells to control the pace of the game. It also includes powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The deck is designed to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage and controlling the board through a combination of spells and creatures.
